reason.general_explanation: CQF uses two queues (Q6 and Q7) that alternate every cycle. Frames are enqueued in one queue while the other transmits. For cut-through switches, the WCD includes transmission delays, propagation delays, switching delays, synchronization errors, and potential buffering at each hop.

wcd_equation.formula: WCD = sum_over_hops(T_trans + T_prop + T_sw + T_sync) + T_buffering

components.T_buffering: CQF buffering = (hop_count - 1) * cycle_duration for worst case alignment

wcd_equation.cqf_specific: In CQF, frames may wait up to one cycle duration at each intermediate switch if they arrive just after the transmission window closes. For cut-through with CQF, worst case adds (N-1)*cycle_duration where N is hop count.

cqf_parameters.queue_alternation: CQF uses two queues (Q6 and Q7) that alternate every cycle
cqf_parameters.queue_assignment: Flows alternate between odd (Q7) and even (Q6) cycles

WCD_calculation.equation: WCD = offset_start + (hops - 1) × C + Σ(transmission_delay + propagation_delay + switching_delay + sync_error) for all hops

WCD_equation.general_formula: WCD = offset_start + (hops - 1) × C + Σ[T_trans(i) + T_prop(i) + T_sw(i) + T_sync(i)] for i=1 to hops

where.offset_start: Start time offset from sending node (given as 0 for all flows)
where.hops: Number of hops in the path
where.T_sync: Time synchronization error per hop (1 µs)

WCD_equation.CQF_worst_case: In CQF, worst case occurs when a frame just misses its transmission window and must wait for the next cycle. With cut-through switching, the queue delay is (hops-1) × cycle_duration because the first hop doesn't experience queuing delay (frame enters immediately), but each subsequent hop may need to wait up to one full cycle for the correct queue to open.

cqf_parameters.cycle_based_forwarding: Frames received in cycle N are forwarded in cycle N+1
cqf_parameters.offset_start_time: All flows start at offset 0 from source node

WCD_equation.formula: WCD = Transmission_delays + Propagation_delays + Switching_delays + CQF_queuing_delays + Time_sync_errors
WCD_equation.detailed_formula: WCD = sum(frame_transmission_time_per_hop) + (hop_count × propagation_delay) + (hop_count × switching_delay) + ((hop_count - 1) × cycle_duration) + (hop_count × time_sync_error)
WCD_equation.overhead_breakdown: Preamble(7) + SFD(1) + DA(6) + SA(6) + VLAN(4) + Type(2) + FCS(4) + IFG(12) = 42 bytes, reduced to 38 for cut-through
WCD_equation.cqf_queuing_delay_per_switch: cycle_duration (worst case: frame just misses current cycle)

WCD_calculation.step_1: Calculate frame size = payload + 38 bytes overhead
WCD_calculation.step_3: Calculate total transmission delay = transmission_time × hop_count
WCD_calculation.step_8: WCD = total_transmission + total_propagation + total_switching + cqf_queuing + time_sync_error

general_explanation.CQF_mechanism: Cyclic Queuing and Forwarding uses two queues (7 and 6) that alternate every cycle. While one queue transmits, the other receives, ensuring deterministic forwarding without interference.
general_explanation.WCD_formula: WCD = T_tx_source + (H-1) * C + H * (T_prop + T_sw) + T_sync + T_tx_last

WCD_components.T_tx_source: Transmission time at source = (Payload + Overhead) * 8 / Bandwidth
WCD_components.H: Number of hops in the path
WCD_components.T_tx_last: Transmission time at last hop (same as source)
WCD_components.Overhead: Ethernet overhead = 42 bytes (Preamble:8 + DA:6 + SA:6 + Type:2 + FCS:4 + IFG:12)

general_explanation.Hypercycle_calculation: LCM(1000, 2500, 5000) = 5000 µs, which equals 100 cycles of 50 µs each. However, for WCD calculation, the base cycle of 50 µs is used.
general_explanation.Queue_assignment: Flows alternate between queue 7 (odd cycles) and queue 6 (even cycles) based on the cycle number modulo 2.

WCD_equation.formula: WCD = T_trans + (N_hops - 1) * (T_prop + T_switch + T_sync) + N_switches * T_cycle + T_prop

where.T_trans: Transmission time of frame at first hop = (Payload + 38) * 8 / 100,000,000 seconds
where.T_sync: Time synchronization error = 1 µs per hop
where.T_cycle: Cycle duration = 50 µs (worst case queuing delay per switch)

WCD_equation.simplified: WCD = T_trans + N_hops * T_prop + (N_hops - 1) * (T_switch + T_sync) + (N_hops - 1) * T_cycle

all_parameters_used.queue_assignment: Q7 for odd cycles, Q6 for even cycles

WCD_calculation.general_formula: WCD = T_transmission + N_hops * T_propagation + (N_hops - 1) * (T_switching + T_sync_error + T_cycle)

components.T_cycle: 50 µs per switch (worst case CQF queuing delay)

WCD_calculation.cut_through_note: Transmission delay only counted at source; switches forward as soon as destination address is read
WCD_calculation.cqf_worst_case: Frame arrives just after queue closes, waits full cycle duration (50 µs) at each switch

general_explanation.cut_through_benefit: Cut-through switches forward frames before complete reception, reducing per-hop delay to propagation + switching delay only

global_parameters.queue_alternation: odd cycle uses queue 7, even cycle uses queue 6

hypercycle_calculation.description: Hypercycle is LCM of all flow periods

cqf_parameters.description: CQF uses two queues that alternate every cycle. A frame arriving in cycle N is buffered in one queue and transmitted in cycle N+1 from the other queue.
cqf_parameters.buffering_behavior: Frames are held for one full cycle at each hop
cqf_parameters.per_hop_delay: 1 cycle duration + transmission time + propagation delay + switching delay + sync error

wcd_equation.formula: WCD = offset_at_source + sum_over_hops(cycle_duration + transmission_time + propagation_delay + switching_delay + sync_error) + final_transmission_time
wcd_equation.simplified: WCD = 0 + (num_hops - 1) × (cycle + tx_time + prop + switch + sync) + tx_time_last_hop + prop + sync

components.overhead_breakdown: Preamble(7) + SFD(1) + DA(6) + SA(6) + VLAN(4) + Type(2) + FCS(4) + IFG(12) = 42 bytes, reduced to 38 for cut-through

WCD_calculation.general_formula: WCD = (num_hops - 1) × cycle_duration + num_hops × (transmission_time + propagation_delay + sync_error) + switching_delay × (num_switches)
WCD_calculation.simplified_per_hop: For CQF with cut-through: each hop adds approximately (cycle/num_hops + tx + prop + sync + switch)
WCD_calculation.note: CQF introduces one cycle buffering delay at each switch hop. Cut-through reduces switching delay. Final WCD is dominated by cycle boundaries.

global_parameters.hypercycle_calculation: LCM(all_flow_periods) = LCM(1000, 2500, 5000) = 5000 us, but for CQF scheduling we use cycle_duration = 50 us as the base cycle

cqf_parameters.description: CQF uses two queues that alternate every cycle. In odd cycles, queue 7 transmits while queue 6 receives. In even cycles, queue 6 transmits while queue 7 receives.
cqf_parameters.queue_alternation: Odd cycle: Q7 transmits, Q6 receives; Even cycle: Q6 transmits, Q7 receives
cqf_parameters.offset_start_time: All flows start at offset 0 from source node

WCD_equation.formula: WCD = transmission_delay_first_hop + sum(propagation_delay + switching_delay + transmission_delay) for intermediate hops + propagation_delay_last_hop + cycle_alignment_penalty + time_sync_error
WCD_equation.detailed_formula: WCD = T_trans_first + (N_hops - 1) * (T_prop + T_switch + T_trans_max_intermediate) + T_prop_last + T_cycle_alignment + T_sync_error
WCD_equation.transmission_delay_calculation: T_trans = (frame_size_bits) / (bandwidth_bps) where frame_size = payload + headers (Ethernet 38 bytes overhead: 8 preamble + 14 Ethernet + 4 VLAN + 4 CRC + 12 IFG)
WCD_equation.cycle_alignment_penalty: For CQF, at each hop, frame may wait up to one cycle duration (50 us) if it arrives during transmission phase of current queue
WCD_equation.cut_through_switching: Cut-through switches begin forwarding after reading header, minimal switching delay of 1 us

all_parameters_used.overhead_breakdown: 8 (preamble) + 14 (Ethernet header) + 4 (VLAN tag) + 4 (FCS/CRC) + 12 (interframe gap) = 42 bytes, but typically 38 bytes used for frame calculation

WCD_calculation.general_formula: WCD = T_trans_first_hop + sum_over_intermediate_hops(T_prop + T_switch + T_trans) + T_prop_last_hop + T_sync_error
WCD_calculation.note: For CQF with cut-through switching and synchronized network, worst case occurs when frame experiences maximum transmission delays at each hop. Since all flows are TT with PCP=7 (highest priority) and CQF provides deterministic queue alternation, cycle alignment penalty is minimized. The calculation assumes best-case CQF scheduling where frames don't wait for queue alternation.

cqf_mechanism_details.first_hop_penalty: Maximum waiting time at source can be up to one full cycle (50 µs)
cqf_mechanism_details.intermediate_hops: Synchronized switching minimizes additional cycle delays at intermediate switches

cqf_mechanism.buffering_delay: Frames may wait up to one cycle duration if arriving at wrong queue phase
cqf_mechanism.worst_case_buffering: One full cycle (50 µs) at first hop if misaligned

components.T_tx_first: Transmission time of frame at first hop = (Frame_size_bits) / Bandwidth
components.Frame_size_bits: (Payload + Headers) × 8, where Headers = 38 bytes (Ethernet 18B + VLAN 4B + CRC included + IFG 12B + Preamble 8B)
components.T_switch: Switching delay per hop = 1 µs (cut-through, applies to hops 2 to N)
components.T_sync: Time synchronization error per hop = 1 µs
components.T_cqf_buffer: CQF buffering delay, worst case = 0 µs (best case alignment assumed for TT traffic with offset 0)
components.N_hops: Number of hops in the path

wcd_equation.note: For TT traffic with offset 0 and proper CQF scheduling, frames are aligned to cycle boundaries, minimizing CQF buffering. Worst case assumes no additional cycle wait.

CQF_mechanism.queue_assignment: Flows alternate between Q7 (odd cycles) and Q6 (even cycles)

WCD_equation.formula: WCD = (H - 1) × C + Σ(transmission_delay + propagation_delay + switching_delay) + time_sync_error

components.H: Number of hops in the path

CQF_specific.worst_case_scenario: Frame arrives just after queue closes, waits full cycle at first hop, then propagates through network
CQF_specific.explanation: In CQF, at each switch hop (except the last), a frame may wait up to one full cycle if it arrives just after the transmission queue closes. With cut-through switching, subsequent hops have minimal additional cycle penalties as the frame flows through the alternating queues.

cqf_mechanism.description: CQF alternates between two queues per cycle. Queue selection alternates: odd cycles use Q7, even cycles use Q6.
cqf_mechanism.isolation: Frames from different cycles never interfere due to strict queue separation
cqf_mechanism.per_hop_delay: Each hop incurs: transmission_time + propagation_delay + switching_delay + cycle_alignment_delay

wcd_equation.formula: WCD = offset_at_source + sum_over_hops(transmission_time + propagation_delay + switching_delay + cycle_wait) + time_sync_error

components.cycle_wait_us: worst case = cycle_duration (50 µs) when frame just misses current cycle
components.total_hops: number of switch-to-switch or switch-to-node transmissions

wcd_equation.detailed_formula: WCD = 0 + Σ(i=1 to hops)[T_trans(i) + T_prop + T_switch + T_cycle_wait] + T_sync_error
wcd_equation.cqf_specific: In CQF, worst case cycle wait at first hop = cycle_duration. Subsequent hops have frames aligned to cycle boundaries, but cut-through switching and cycle boundaries mean each hop can incur up to one cycle delay in worst case.

simplified_wcd_calculation.explanation: For CQF with cut-through switches, the worst-case delay includes: (1) Initial cycle wait at source (up to 50µs), (2) Transmission time of first hop, (3) For each subsequent hop: propagation (1µs) + switching (1µs), (4) Final transmission at last hop, (5) Time sync error (1µs)

cqf_mechanism.operation: Frames alternate between two queues (Q7 and Q6) based on cycle parity. While one queue transmits, the other receives.
cqf_mechanism.cycle_assignment: Frames are assigned to odd/even queues based on their arrival cycle within the hypercycle

wcd_equation.formula: WCD = T_serialization_first_hop + (N_hops - 1) × (T_switching + T_propagation + T_serialization) + T_cycle + 2 × T_sync_error

components.Frame_size_bits: (Payload_bytes + 38) × 8, where 38 bytes = 18B Ethernet overhead + 20B guard band
components.T_sync_error: 1 µs (applied twice for source and destination)
components.N_hops: Number of hops in the path

wcd_equation.rationale: In CQF, the worst-case occurs when a frame just misses its transmission cycle and must wait for the next cycle (T_cycle). Cut-through switching allows transmission to begin before full frame reception at intermediate hops.
